items.text:
Amazing sandbox space sim.
Start with a crappy old ship and a huge mortgage, salvage wrecks to sell for profit, expand and upgrade your ship, learn new skills.

Get a crew or go it alone. Pilot the ship from a console with proper Newtonian physics.

The first 10 hours or so can be rough, getting used to the UI and how all the systems work, but if you can push through there is a real gem underneath.
items.text_zh:
了不起的沙盒太空模拟游戏。
从一艘破旧的老船和巨额抵押贷款开始，打捞残骸卖钱获利，扩建并升级你的飞船，学习新技能。

招募船员或独自行动。在控制台上以真正的牛顿物理学驾驶飞船。

最初 10 个小时左右可能会很艰难，要适应 UI 以及所有系统的运作方式，但如果你能撑过去，底下藏着一颗真正的宝石。

observations.description: 前10小时左右适应UI和系统运作比较困难
